# RedoSan Authenticity

> Free, open-source digital authenticity suite: watermark images, audio and
> documents, verify file fingerprints, read EXIF metadata, issue C2PA
> provenance, DID identities and signed certificates. Runs 100% in the
> browser — no uploads, nothing leaves the user's device.

Main application: https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/
Source: https://github.com/Redo-San/RedoSan-Authenticity (GPL-2.0)
Maintainer: Redo-San — https://github.com/Redo-San

## Tools

- [Digital Watermark](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/watermark/index.html): 9 image watermarking algorithms (LSB, DCT, DWT and more).
- [Digital Audio Watermark](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/audio-watermark/index.html): hide secrets in WAV audio (LSB, phase coding, echo hiding, DSSS, QIM).
- [Pixel Injection](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/pixel-injection/index.html): 20+ advanced pixel-injection algorithms.
- [Face Biometric](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/face-biometric/index.html): local face registration and verification; templates never leave the device.
- [Forensic Analyzer](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/forensic/index.html): ELA, noise analysis, JPEG markers, tamper checks.
- [ID Forge](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/id_forge/index.html): UUID v4/v7, ULID, NanoID, SWHID generators.
- [Digital Fingerprint](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/fingerprint/index.html): SHA-2/SHA-3 family, BLAKE2/3, RIPEMD-160, Whirlpool, perceptual hashes.
- [Metadata Reader](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/metadata/index.html): EXIF and format inspection.
- [Timestamp](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/timestamp/index.html): OpenTimestamps create / verify / upgrade.
- [DID Identity](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/did/index.html): did:key generation and signing (Ed25519, P-256, RSA).
- [C2PA Provenance](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/c2pa/index.html): read and write content credentials.
- [Digital Passport](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/certificate/index.html): signed PDF/DOCX/EPUB certificates.
- [File Converter](https://redo-san.github.io/RedoSan-Authenticity/Style/pages/converter/index.html): FFmpeg.wasm-powered media conversion.

## Notes for AI crawlers

The landing page at https://redo-san.github.io/ is a brand surface; the
interactive application lives under /RedoSan-Authenticity/. Everything is
client-side only: no accounts, no telemetry, no server-side processing.
